title: OneOfBooleanAndConstBranches
description: A oneOf mixing an object branch with branches the sealed-interface union cannot select on. Selection decodes a const, an enum and a boolean `false` branch into `any`, which matches every document -- so a document satisfying exactly one branch was counted as matching all of them and refused, and a document satisfying none was left at one match and accepted. The all-object group beside them is the control: it selects correctly and must keep its union.
